_note: Character briefs (shown at the top of each script sheet in art-source/voices/scripts/) and each character's Kokoro voice: `voice` is one of Kokoro's, or `mix` blends several by weight, read in an American (`lang` 'a') or British ('b') accent; `speed` 1 is normal. After changing someone's voice: npm run voices -- --redo=<speaker> --generate. Compare them with npm run voices -- --audition.

rookie.name: Rookie
rookie.who: The player. A young fighter, early twenties, from nothing, working his way into Victor Sable's crew.
rookie.direction: Low-key and guarded, quietly confident; dry humour. Never shouts unless cornered. Natural, not 'movie tough'.

lucas.name: Lucas
lucas.who: Rookie's friend from the gym and Victor's go-between. Late twenties.
lucas.direction: Warm, quick, a little fast-talking; easy charm. In Scene 04 he's under strain: clipped, nervous, covering it.

victor.name: Victor Sable
victor.who: The boss. Fifties. Owns the gym, the estate, and half the city.
victor.direction: Calm, low, unhurried. Never raises his voice; every pause is on purpose. Warm when it suits him, which makes it worse.

sal.name: Sal
sal.who: Runs the warehouse at Pier Nine. Sixties, been on the docks forever.
sal.direction: Gravelly, gruff, suspicious; short sentences. Unimpressed by everyone.

nico.name: Nico
nico.who: A jumpy contact at Calder Yard who knows he's in over his head.
nico.direction: Fast, anxious, talks too much; laughs when he's scared.

stranger.name: The Stranger
stranger.who: A Varga crew man watching Calder Yard.
stranger.direction: Cold, quiet, menacing; very even. Smiles with his voice, never with his words.

marco.name: Marco
marco.who: A cocky young fighter at the gym who wants Rookie's spot.
marco.direction: Brash, loud, showing off for the room; trash talk.

caller.name: The Caller
caller.who: An unknown number on Rookie's phone: someone from the Varga crew.
caller.direction: Slow, controlled, threatening; a voice that's done this before. Slightly 'on the phone'.

local.name: The Resident
local.who: A woman who lives at Mercer House. Fifties or sixties; has seen trouble come and go.
local.direction: Wary, tired, sharp-tongued; warms a little if treated with respect.

guard1.name: Bodyguard
guard1.who: One of Victor's men on the door.
guard1.direction: Flat, curt, bored authority. Few words.

sentry.name: Sentry
sentry.who: One of Victor's men at the gym.
